statement: The 2019 communication anticipates climate pressure on water and describes competing control/use among water managers, recommending basin coordination. The passage concerns administrative resource governance, not documented armed conflict.

statement: Source dated 2022-06 reports: The NDC relies on only two ASECNA stations, in Malabo and Bata; cited trends show significantly rising temperatures in Malabo but a different pattern in Bata, with no significant accumulated-rainfall trend.
